ambiguities.detail: API is Elysia (new Elysia() chain in src/app.ts, .use() module mounts, per-module prefix + .get/.post/... calls). Standalone Elysia route detection is out of v0.1-alpha scope: routes[] is deliberately empty. A REST-only or Next-only detector must report the boundary, never fabricate routes.

Module prefixes can be imported constants (SCIM_PREFIX = '/scim/v2' in src/modules/scim/resource.ts:15, used as prefix in scim/index.ts). Resolving them needs cross-file constant folding — beyond v0.1-alpha.
await loadExternalServerPlugins() (src/index.ts:7) loads plugins from HELENA_PLUGINS_DIR before the first request — plugin routes are unknowable statically.
startBackgroundJobs() (src/background.ts) — janitor loops, engine ticks, queue claiming; runtime behavior, unknown statically.
src/scripts/*/run.ts contain their own .listen() calls (one-off scripts). A naive 'find listen' entry detector must not report script entries as servers.

entryPoints.form: app.listen({ hostname, port, idleTimeout }) — object form (Bun/Elysia), not app.listen(port)
entryPoints.note: Named by package.json scripts (dev: bun --watch src/index.ts, start: bun run src/index.ts). App assembled without listen in src/app.ts so tests can drive routes in memory.

excludedFacts.detail: Per-module Elysia route inventories (prefix + method calls) not enumerated — Elysia detection out of scope.
Hook->route guard attribution (onBeforeHandle etc.) follows plugin boundaries; not mapped.

importCases.note: package.json 'imports' subpath pattern '#modules/*' -> './src/modules/*.ts' (Bun-native; NOT tsconfig paths). Analyzer probe: R.
package.json 'imports' '#shared/*' -> './src/shared/*.ts'. tsconfig.base.json has no 'paths' (grepped) — the imports field is the only alias mechanism. Analyzer probe: R.
